tagline: Your own RustDesk server with a web console, accounts, an address book on every client and devices that can change their ID.
description: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop for Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and iOS. This server adds a web console, user accounts, a shared address book and a web client to the ID server and the relay.
author: Junker der Provinz

tips.before_install: Set RELAY, RUSTDESK_API_RUSTDESK_ID_SERVER, RUSTDESK_API_RUSTDESK_RELAY_SERVER, RUSTDESK_API_RUSTDESK_API_SERVER under Custom Installation before the first start.

title: RustDesk
